guard: a command that renders no TUI loads no ink or yoga-layout module, so a large argv cannot stall the CLI before the command runs
why: The suite runs bin/dist/cotal.js, which loads @cotal-ai/cli from dist, so the command builds
the CLI first and afterRestore rebuilds it, so no dist compiled from the mutant is left behind.
The mutation restores the defect: a static ink import at the top of commands/console.ts. The
named assertion is the module-graph cell because it discriminates on every platform. The
640 KB argv cell also goes red on macOS, where the stall reproduces, and passes on Linux.
